$comment: Machine-readable catalog of prompt-relevant @miragon/mcp-toolkit-ui building blocks. Hand-maintained, source of truth is packages/ui/src/. A Vitest drift-guard (src/ui-catalog.test.ts) asserts every `export` named here is actually exported from its `importPath` barrel, so this file cannot silently drift from the code. Consumed by the docs/reference/components.md page and the build-mcp-widget skill. `importPath` is one of: '@miragon/mcp-toolkit-ui' (root barrel, mcp-use/react-free), '@miragon/mcp-toolkit-ui/app' (MCP app shell, imports mcp-use/react), '@miragon/mcp-toolkit-ui/hooks' (view-tool hooks).

components.name: Card

props.name: size
props.description: Compact spacing when 'sm'. Default 'default'.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root div via cn().

components.whenToUse: The default container for any widget. Compose CardHeader/CardTitle/CardContent/CardFooter instead of building a bordered div by hand.

components.name: Badge

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Default 'default'.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the badge.

components.whenToUse: Inline status/label pill. For a tone-driven status dot or count, see LivePill/CountPill.

components.name: Button

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Default 'default'.

props.name: size
props.description: Size token. Default 'default'.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the single child as the button (Radix Slot) instead of a <button>.

props.name: ...buttonProps
props.description: onClick, disabled, aria-*, etc.

components.whenToUse: Any clickable action. Wire onClick to a host action (useHostBridge / useHostActions) or a mutation.

components.name: Input

props.name: ...inputProps
props.description: value, onChange, placeholder, type, etc.

components.whenToUse: Single-line text/number entry in interactive widgets.

components.name: Select

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Selection callback.

components.whenToUse: Pick one option from a list (e.g. a scope/period filter that drives a self-fetch).

components.name: Switch

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled on/off state.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Toggle callback.

components.whenToUse: Boolean toggle (e.g. include-resolved, live-refresh).

components.name: Table
components.whenToUse: Tabular markup. Compose the parts for a list/array tool result; add a ListFooter for pagination.

components.name: Tabs

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active tab value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Active-tab callback.

components.whenToUse: Split a busy widget into sections (e.g. one tab per process key). The WidgetRenderer also uses Tabs for tabbed layouts.

components.name: Dialog

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Open-state callback.

components.whenToUse: Confirm a destructive action or show detail in a modal.

components.name: Sheet

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Open-state callback.

components.whenToUse: Slide-in side panel for detail/edit without leaving the widget.

components.name: Alert

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style.

components.whenToUse: Inline notice or error message inside a widget body.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.whenToUse: Constrain a long list to a fixed height with a styled scrollbar.

components.name: Skeleton

props.name: className
props.description: Size the placeholder (e.g. 'h-20 w-full').

components.whenToUse: Loading placeholder while a self-fetch is in flight — avoids layout shift on first paint.

components.name: Separator

props.name: orientation
props.description: Default 'horizontal'.

components.whenToUse: Visual divider between sections of a card.

components.name: GridLayout

props.name: children
props.description: GridItem children.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the grid container (e.g. to change the gap).

components.whenToUse: Lay out KPI tiles / sub-cards in a 12-column responsive grid. Wrap each cell in <GridItem span={n}>. Same grid WidgetRenderer uses internally.

components.name: GridItem

props.name: span
props.description: Column span 1–12. Default 12 (full width); out-of-range falls back to full width.

props.name: children
props.description: Cell content.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the cell.

components.whenToUse: A cell inside GridLayout. e.g. <GridItem span={4}> for a one-third-width tile.

components.name: KpiGrid

props.name: cells
props.description: Metric cells flowed as columns (1–6, clamped). Each: { label, value, fraction?, trend?, trendDirection?, tone?, onClick?, ariaLabel? }. A cell with onClick renders as a button (drill into a detail view).

props.name: boxed
props.description: Wrap the strip in a bordered card with an optional header. Default false (lighter border-y strip).

props.name: header
props.description: Group header shown above the strip when boxed: { label, badge? }.

components.whenToUse: Show a row of headline metrics in a widget (replaces the old single-metric KPICard). Pre-format values for locale/currency. Set a cell tone for emphasis (e.g. 'danger') and onClick to make a metric a drill target.

components.name: LivePill

props.name: tone
props.description: Status tone driving the dot + tint ('neutral'|'info'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'). Default 'info'.

props.name: children
props.description: Pill label. Defaults to 'Live'.

components.whenToUse: Signal live/real-time data in a widget header — a tinted pill with a pulsing dot.

components.name: CountPill

props.name: tone
props.description: Status tone driving the tint. Default 'neutral'.

props.name: children
props.description: The count/value (rendered with tabular numbers).

components.whenToUse: Right-aligned count indicator on a list/group row (e.g. a per-group item count).

components.name: SectionHeading

props.name: title
props.description: The section title.

props.name: hint
props.description: Muted hint shown on the right (e.g. a count).

props.name: trailing
props.description: Right-aligned slot that overrides hint when set (e.g. a control).

components.whenToUse: Label a block inside a widget body (a list or sub-table) without the weight of a full card header.

components.name: WidgetHeader

props.name: title
props.description: The widget title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon/glyph rendered in a tinted tile above the title.

props.name: iconTone
props.description: Tone for the icon tile. Default 'neutral'.

props.name: sub
props.description: Subtitle/meta row under the title (e.g. a LivePill + counts).

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned actions slot (buttons, drill controls).

components.whenToUse: Anchor the top of a dashboard widget surface: tinted icon tile, large title, meta row, and an actions slot. Use once per widget.

components.name: GroupCard

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the body is expanded.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Toggle handler for the summary bar.

props.name: summary
props.description: Always-visible summary bar (may contain its own buttons/links; clicks on those don't toggle).

props.name: children
props.description: Collapsible body, rendered only when expanded.

components.whenToUse: Group related rows behind an expandable header (e.g. items grouped by a key). Replaces a hand-rolled Collapsible for list grouping.

components.name: FilterBar

props.name: search
props.description: Current search text (controlled).

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called with the new search text on every keystroke.

props.name: chips
props.description: Toggleable filter chips: { id, label, count?, active? }.

props.name: onChipToggle
props.description: Called with a chip id when it is toggled.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search input. Default 'Filter…'.

components.whenToUse: Filter a list/table of widget items with a search box + chip row. Pair with useDebouncedValue so a server-side filter only re-queries once typing pauses.

components.name: DrillButton

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: onDrill
props.description: Drill/navigation handler — wire to in-widget navigation (e.g. useHostActions().showWidget).

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading glyph; the trailing → is always rendered.

props.name: size
props.description: 'sm' for table rows, 'md' for surface headers. Default 'sm'.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label when the visible text is terse.

components.whenToUse: The single neutral in-widget navigation control (drill into a detail/sub-view). Use it for every drill so they read identically and stay visually quieter than primary/agentic actions.

components.name: ListFooter

props.name: shown
props.description: How many rows are currently rendered.

props.name: total
props.description: Total rows available. Renders nothing when 0.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether a 'Load more' button is shown.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the user asks for the next page.

props.name: loadingMore
props.description: Disables the button + shows a loading label while a fetch is in flight.

props.name: noun
props.description: Plural noun for the count, e.g. 'instances'. Default 'rows'.

components.whenToUse: Footer for a paginated list: an honest 'Showing X of Y' total + an explicit 'Load more' (not infinite scroll).

components.name: Tone tokens
components.whenToUse: Record<ToneVariant, string> maps from a status tone ('neutral'|'info'|'success'|'warning'|'danger') to Tailwind class strings (TONE_SOFT = soft tint, TONE_DOT = dot colour, TONE_TEXT = text colour), backed by the semantic status tokens in globals.css and re-skinned by the theme. Use to colour a custom element by status without a tone === 'x' ? ... ternary; the tone-aware components (KpiGrid, LivePill, CountPill, WidgetHeader) consume these internally.

components.name: useDebouncedValue

props.name: value
props.description: The value to debounce.

props.name: delayMs
props.description: Debounce delay in ms. Default 300.

components.whenToUse: Debounce a search box (e.g. FilterBar's search) so a server-side filter only re-queries once the user pauses typing. Returns the value delayed by delayMs.

components.name: useToolQuery

props.name: queryKey
props.description: Cache key. args is appended automatically so callers with different args get separate cache entries.

props.name: toolName
props.description: MCP tool to call (e.g. a generated *_data feed).

props.name: args
props.description: Tool arguments.

props.name: opts
props.description: Gate the query / transform data on read.

components.whenToUse: Self-fetch arbitrary data from a tool inside a cockpit-embedded widget. Result is decoded with parseToolResult (structured-first). Returns a TanStack UseQueryResult.

components.name: useToolMutation

props.name: toolName
props.description: MCP tool to invoke as the mutation.

props.name: opts
props.description: Query keys to refetch on success.

components.whenToUse: Run a write/action tool (e.g. retry-incident) and refetch dependent queries. Returns a TanStack UseMutationResult; call .mutate(args).

components.name: useViewToolQuery

props.name: queryKey
props.description: Cache key; args appended automatically (sibling widgets dedupe).

props.name: toolName
props.description: A *_show_* widget tool whose structuredContent is the full view envelope.

props.name: args
props.description: Tool arguments.

props.name: opts
props.description: Gate the query.

components.whenToUse: Self-fetch from a *_show_* widget tool. Unwraps the McpAppView view envelope via parseViewToolResult (single-step → flat data, multi-step → keyed by step id) — the envelope-aware sibling of useToolQuery.

components.name: useViewData

props.name: initialData
props.description: Host-pushed data (e.g. from adaptDataWidget). Returned verbatim when present.

props.name: key
props.description: Cache key for the fallback self-fetch.

props.name: tool
props.description: Tool to call when initialData is absent.

props.name: args
props.description: Tool arguments for the fallback fetch.

props.name: ready
props.description: Whether the required id/key is present; fetch is disabled until ready and only when no initialData.

components.whenToUse: The dual-mode seam: write ONE widget that renders host-pushed data when handed it (standalone *_show_* widget) AND self-fetches when embedded in a cockpit. Returns { data, loading, error }.

components.name: useIsMobile
components.whenToUse: Switch a widget between compact and wide layouts below the 768px breakpoint. Returns boolean.

components.name: useHostBridge
components.whenToUse: THE host seam for portable widgets. Returns a HostBridge { callTool, sendFollowup, openExternal, getWidgetData, setModelContext?, theme? }. Use this instead of mcp-use/react or window.openai directly so the same widget runs in the mcp-use host, ChatGPT, or standalone. Never returns null.

components.name: useHostActions
components.whenToUse: Named-affordance facade over useHostBridge: returns { openLink, showWidget, askAi }. Handy for in-widget navigation (showWidget) and handing open-ended tasks to the agent (askAi). New portable widgets can also use useHostBridge directly.

components.name: buildShowWidgetIntent

props.name: toolName
props.description: The *_show_* tool the agent should invoke.

props.name: description
props.description: Natural-language description of what to show.

components.whenToUse: Build the intent string for host.showWidget(...) — appends a '(use <toolName>)' hint so the agent picks the right tool unambiguously.

components.name: HostBridgeProvider

props.name: bridge
props.description: The explicit bridge to provide (createChatGptHostBridge / createStandaloneHostBridge / createMcpUseHostBridge).

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree whose useHostBridge() resolves to this bridge.

components.whenToUse: Wrap a portable widget in the bridge for the host it runs in. Omit it inside the toolkit's own host (useHostBridge falls back to the mcp-use bridge).

components.name: createStandaloneHostBridge

props.name: options
props.description: { callTool (required), getData?, onFollowup?, onOpenExternal?, onModelContext?, theme? }.

components.whenToUse: Build a HostBridge for a standalone web app against any MCP server (callTool usually wraps a @modelcontextprotocol/sdk client). The WidgetFixtureHost builds on this too.

components.name: createChatGptHostBridge

props.name: sdk
props.description: Explicit window.openai for testing; defaults to the real one.

components.whenToUse: Build a HostBridge mapping the bridge verbs onto the OpenAI Apps SDK (ChatGPT). Defensive — missing host methods degrade to logged no-ops.

components.name: adaptDataWidget

props.name: Widget
props.type: ComponentType<{ data: T | null } & Record<string, unknown>>
props.description: A single-data widget — write it as ({ data }) and it stays host-agnostic.

props.name: dataType
props.description: The step _dataType to pull data from in context.steps.

props.name: describeForModel
props.description: (data, props) => string. Wraps the widget in <ModelContext> so the model knows what the user is looking at.

components.whenToUse: Register a hand-built ({ data }) widget as a framework WidgetComponent. The adapter finds the matching step in context.steps[_dataType].data and forwards result.data as the data prop, and spreads per-cell layout props. Lets render-view and *_show_* tools share one widget.

components.name: DescribeForModel

props.name: (type)
props.description: The describeForModel callback signature for adaptDataWidget.

components.whenToUse: Type the model-context line builder you pass to adaptDataWidget — report view identity, active filters, and headline numbers so the agent has context on the next turn.

components.name: parseToolResult

props.name: result
props.description: The raw MCP tool result.

props.name: opts
props.description: Channel preference. Default 'structured' (structuredContent-first).

components.whenToUse: Decode a raw callTool result to its data payload. Structured-first: isError → throw, then structuredContent, then JSON-decoded text, then raw. useToolQuery decodes through this for you.

components.name: parseViewToolResult

props.name: result
props.description: The raw result of a *_show_* widget tool.

components.whenToUse: Unwrap a *_show_* view envelope (context.stepData) to the flat widget data: single-step → that step's data; multi-step → object keyed by step id. Non-envelope results pass through parseToolResult.

components.name: cn

props.name: ...classes
props.description: clsx inputs.

components.whenToUse: Merge Tailwind class strings (clsx + tailwind-merge). Use for conditional/override classes; later conflicting utilities win.

components.name: createTheme

props.name: tokens
props.description: Curated brand tokens (all optional): primary, primaryForeground, accent, accentForeground, background, foreground, card, cardForeground, border, ring, radius, fontSans, fontHeading. Colors are any CSS color string (oklch/hex/hsl).

props.name: opts
props.description: Dark-mode token overrides, applied on top of the .dark defaults when the active mode is dark.

components.whenToUse: Define a white-label theme from a single set of brand tokens. Maps the curated fields onto the real CSS variables (--primary, --radius, ...) and returns a serializable ThemeDefinition { vars, darkVars?, toStyle() }. Apply it with ThemeProvider so every primitive re-skins to the client's brand.

components.name: ThemeProvider

props.name: theme
props.description: The theme from createTheme/themePresets to apply. Omit to manage only the light/dark mode against the toolkit defaults.

props.name: mode
props.description: Color-scheme mode. Default 'light'. Pass HostBridge.theme to follow the host, or 'system' to track prefers-color-scheme (SSR-safe).

props.name: as
props.description: Scope wrapper element. Default 'div'.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the scope wrapper.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that inherits the theme's CSS variables and dark class.

components.whenToUse: Wrap a widget (or a whole app) to apply a ThemeDefinition. Renders a wrapper carrying the theme's CSS variables inline (overriding :root) and toggles the .dark class on the scope per mode. React + DOM only — no host required.

components.name: useTheme
components.whenToUse: Read the active theme/mode from the nearest ThemeProvider. Returns { theme, mode, resolvedMode } where resolvedMode is 'system' resolved to 'light'|'dark'. Throws outside a ThemeProvider.

components.name: themePresets
components.whenToUse: Ready-made white-label themes (themePresets.miragon, .violet, .emerald) — a demonstration of createTheme and a fork-able starting point. Pass one to ThemeProvider's theme prop.

components.name: McpToolkitApp

props.name: widgets
props.description: Host-bundled widget registry keyed by widget id.

props.name: widgetLoader
props.description: Loader for upstream-hosted widgets missing from `widgets`. Defaults to read-widget-bundle via the host bridge.

props.name: refreshToolName
props.description: Tool the refresh button invokes. Default 'refresh-view'.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override UI strings (loading, refresh, fullscreen).

components.whenToUse: The recommended consumer root for an mcp-app.html bundle. Wraps McpAppView in mcp-use's McpUseProvider (host auto-sizing, StrictMode, error boundary, theme). You usually do NOT write this when authoring a single widget — you write the widget and register it here.

components.name: WidgetFixtureHost

props.name: widget
props.description: The widget component under development.

props.name: data
props.description: Fixture data: keys map for ({ keys }) widgets, forwarded as data for ({ data }) widgets.

props.name: dataType
props.description: For adaptDataWidget components: seeds a pipeline step whose _dataType matches so the adapter resolves data.

props.name: tools
props.description: Tool fixtures keyed by tool name. A static value or a (args) => result handler. Drives useToolQuery and callTool.

props.name: globals
props.description: Host-context overrides (theme, displayMode, locale...).

props.name: onModelContext
props.description: Receives the serialized <ModelContext> the widget reports — see what the model would see.

props.name: onHostAction
props.description: Receives every host action (tool call, link, follow-up).

components.whenToUse: Storybook-style harness: render ONE widget with fixture data and a mocked host (no backend, no real host). This is the prompt → see → iterate loop; add a Story to examples/widget-playground/stories.ts.

components.name: buildFixtureWidgetProps

props.name: data
props.description: Fixture data used as keys map and (when dataType set) the seeded step's data.

props.name: dataType
props.description: Seed the single pipeline step under this _dataType for adaptDataWidget components.

components.whenToUse: Build the WidgetProps envelope the fixture host passes to a widget — exported mainly for unit testing the envelope shape without rendering React.
